Network Application Group Resource Delete Network Application Group
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/networkApplicationGroups/:groupId

Deletes the custom network application group for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
groupId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the network application group.

Responses
​
default

Successful Operation
